Siren is a DeFi protocol that operates on the Ethereum public blockchain. Siren is built on smart contracts that let users lock collateral to mint tokens representing synthetic positions. Siren is designed around over-collateralized positions, so the collateral must exceed the value of the minted position.

Zeta is a decentralized derivatives exchange that operates on the Solana public blockchain. Zeta offers on-chain options and perpetual futures trading. Zeta runs through smart contracts without a centralized intermediary.

Levana is a decentralized perpetual futures protocol that operates on Cosmos-based public blockchains. Levana offers leveraged trading of perpetual contracts through smart contracts. Levana settles positions on-chain without a centralized intermediary.

Dopex is a decentralized options protocol that operates on the Arbitrum public blockchain. Dopex offers options products through smart contracts. Dopex provides options vaults that pool liquidity from users to sell options on-chain.

Pods is a permissionless options protocol that operates on the Ethereum public blockchain. Pods issues options as tokens through smart contracts. Pods allows users to create and trade option positions on-chain without a centralized intermediary.
